xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5360: Memory facts: source attribution, supersession and a duplicate/contradiction lint

plan.title: Memory facts: source attribution, supersession and a duplicate/contradiction lint
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Curated memory facts cannot record who made a rule or when (pan memory add hardcodes source: null), cannot record what they replace (no supersedes/superseded_by/status; retire deletes the file), and edit silently drops unknown frontmatter keys. Nothing detects duplicate or contradicting facts, so a replaced rule such as dfai disable-timestream-for-sieges-and-caravans stays in every launch index.
narratives.Proposal: Extend the fact frontmatter with created, supersedes, superseded_by and status (keeping source and preserving unknown keys); redefine isActiveFact so superseded and retired facts leave the launch index and search; add pan memory add|edit --source/--supersedes with a validated two-file write that links both ways and never deletes; print attribution and links in show; add list --all; add an advisory pan memory lint that reports link problems, duplicate pairs (embedding similarity with a lexical fallback) and LLM-judged contradictions over the 20 most similar pairs, never editing. retire stays the hard delete. Full detail in .pan/drafts/PAN-5360.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- MCP memory_add or /api/self/memory/facts gaining source or supersedes (sibling issue PAN-5365)
- Migrating existing facts: no created backfill and no automatic supersession of existing facts
- Supersession across stores (project, operator, machine)
- A CLI flag that writes status: retired or undoes a supersession
- Any change to pan memory retire (still a hard delete) or to the pan done uncommitted-fact guard
- pan memory lint editing, fixing, retiring or superseding any fact
- Running the lint at launch, in CI or as a pipeline gate
- Persisting embeddings or lint results
- Dashboard UI for supersession or lint

autoDecisions.summary: Absent status means active; superseded_by alone also makes a fact inactive (D1, D2)
autoDecisions.rationale: Existing files keep their shape and a hand-edited half link can never leave a replaced rule in the index.

autoDecisions.summary: --supersedes looks up ids in the same store only and refuses self, missing and already-superseded-by-another ids (D4, D5)
autoDecisions.rationale: Smallest safe rule set; it makes CLI-created cycles impossible and keeps writes inside one git checkout.

autoDecisions.summary: Both files of a supersession are validated (parse + secret scan) before either is written (D11)
autoDecisions.rationale: A hand-edited old fact can trip the scanner; validating first avoids a half-written supersession.

autoDecisions.summary: show keeps its Source: <file> line and prints the fact source as Attribution: (D12)
autoDecisions.rationale: The Source: line is asserted by tests and read by agents; a new label avoids ambiguity.

autoDecisions.summary: list --review now means review.length > 0; new --all shows every fact (D13)
autoDecisions.rationale: Otherwise superseded facts would appear under --review once isActiveFact changes.

autoDecisions.summary: Similarity uses the conversationSearch embedder when available and falls back to local TF-IDF cosine (D16)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for embedding similarity, but embeddings need an OpenAI key that is often absent; the lint must still work offline.

autoDecisions.summary: Contradiction pass uses the memory extraction provider via extractWithProviderPolicy with a no-op recordHealth, capped at 20 pairs (D17, D18)
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses configured provider selection (no hardcoded model) and bounds cost on large stores (dfai has 172 facts).

autoDecisions.summary: pan memory lint exits 0 after any report (D19)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue calls it an advisory report like /okf lint.

autoDecisions.summary: MCP memory_add source/supersedes deferred to sibling issue PAN-5365 (D21)
autoDecisions.rationale: supersedes via agent token is a trust decision, and the extra src/dashboard subsystem would breach the 6-subsystem plan limit.

autoDecisions.summary: No CLI flag writes status: retired; retire stays the hard delete (D8)
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue lists only --source and --supersedes and says to keep retire as the hard delete.

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5360.md work item W2 and decisions D4, D5, D6, D11. Add MemoryFactSupersedeError and writeSupersedingFact(dir, scope, fact, supersedes, { overwrite, today }) to store.ts. Look up every id in the same dir; refuse an id whose file exists but is listed in problems ('fact "<y>" cannot be parsed (<reason>); fix it first'), a missing id ('no fact "<y>" in <dir>'), a self id ('a fact cannot supersede itself'), a fact superseded by another id ('"<y>" is already superseded by "<z>"'), and in overwrite (edit) mode an edited fact that is itself superseded ('"<x>" is superseded by "<z>"; edit that fact instead'). An id already superseded by this fact id is skipped (idempotent). The new fact's supersedes is the ordered, de-duplicated union of its current list and the new ids. Each old fact is rewritten with status 'superseded', supersededBy = fact.id, updated = today, all other fields (review, source, extra, body) kept. Serialize, parseMemoryFact and redactSensitiveText-check every text before writing any file; write the new fact first then each old fact via temp file + rename; an I/O error after the first write rethrows naming the files already written. Never delete a file.

items.title: Given facts y in the store, writeSupersedingFact for new fact x with supersedes [y] writes x with supersedes [y] and rewrites y with status superseded and superseded_by x, and y.md still exists

Given an old fact whose body was hand-edited to contain secret-like text, writeSupersedingFact rejects before writing and x.md is not created

Lint: lexical and embedding similarity scoring

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only two new files no other item edits.

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5360.md work item W8 and D16. New module src/lib/memory/facts/lint-similarity.ts with the threshold constants (lexical duplicate 0.60, lexical candidate 0.30, embedding duplicate 0.90, embedding candidate 0.75), Embedder, ScoredPair, SimilarityResult, factText, lexicalVectors (lowercase [a-z0-9]+ tokens of length >= 2 minus a fixed stopword list, TF-IDF idf = ln(1 + N/df)), cosine, scoreFactPairs(facts, embedder) and defaultEmbedder() wrapping createConversationEmbeddingProvider() (null + unavailableReason when not enabled). scoreFactPairs returns pairs at or above the method's candidate threshold, a < b, sorted by score desc then ids; an embedder that throws falls back to lexical with fallbackReason (<=200 chars). Takes facts as input (the caller filters active ones); must not import render.ts. Implementation checkpoint from the PRD: score the dfai store (~/Projects/dfai/.overdeck/memory) with a scratch script; if more than 20 pairs score >= 0.60 and most are distinct rules, raise LEXICAL_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD in 0.05 steps up to 0.75; record the final value in the commit message; keep 0.60 if the store is absent. Do not commit the scratch script.

items.title: scoreFactPairs with a null embedder returns a seeded near-duplicate pair with score >= LEXICAL_DUPLICATE_THRESHOLD and method lexical, and does not return an unrelated pair above the candidate threshold
scoreFactPairs with an injected embedder returns method embedding, the embedder model, and scores computed from the injected vectors
scoreFactPairs with an embedder that throws returns method lexical and a fallbackReason containing the thrown message

narrative.Action: See .pan/drafts/PAN-5360.md work item W10 and D15. Reads the store with readMemoryFactsSync; links = findLinkProblems(all parsed facts); similarity and contradictions use facts.filter(isActiveFact) only; duplicates = pairs at or above threshold ?? the method duplicate threshold; contradictions run over all candidate pairs when llm is true, else status skipped with reason 'llm disabled (--no-llm)'. embedder undefined means defaultEmbedder(); null forces lexical; judge undefined means defaultContradictionJudge(identity).
